title: Ancestral and SDE samplers: adding noise back
hook: Why a sampler that keeps injecting noise never settles on one image, and when that helps.

verified.claim: The split into sigma_down and sigma_up is read from get_ancestral_step.
The real function gives 4.5714 and 6.5652 for 14 to 8.
Flow models are sent to sample_euler_ancestral_RF.
Stochastic samplers gave a different answer with another noise seed on the bench.

unchecked: The toy has one number per sample and a perfect denoiser, so its results do not settle whether noise helps on real models.
The Karras et al. quote was checked at the first audit and not re-read this time.
